source: 729 Purpose
target: 729 Propositum

source: Franca had already concealed herself by the time she recognized Perle.
target: Franca se iam celaverat, cum Perlem agnovit.

source: Her plan was to circle around and use the mirror to reflect Perle’s figure, hoping to curse her.
target: Eius consilium erat circumire et speculum ad imaginem Perlei referendam adhibere, sperans eam maledicere.

source: If the curse failed, it would at least create an opening for Jenna to sneak up from the shadows and assassinate the target.
target: Si maledictio deficeret, saltem ostium pareret ut Jenna a tenebris furtim accesseret et propositum occideret.

source: Though not as cunning as Lumian the Conspirer, both Jenna and Franca instinctively sensed that the sudden assaulting Perle was incredibly dangerous, even more so than Moran Avigny.
target: Quamquam non tam callidi ut Lumian Coniurator, et Jenna et Franca intuitu sentiverunt Perlem repentinam, quae oppugnatione imminuebatur, incredibiliter periculosam esse, etiam magis quam Moran Avigny.

source: However, they didn’t go so far as to suspect her of being an Overseer or demigod.
target: Tamen non egerunt ad id ut eam ut Inspectorem aut semideum suspicerent.

source: As Perle uttered the Words of Order, Franca felt slender, snake‐like entities emerge from the surrounding shadows, enveloping her despite her invisibility.
target: Cum Perle verba Ordinis effuderet, Franca sensit entia gracilia, serpentium similia, ex circumstantibus umbris emergere, eam compleverant, non obstante eius invisibilitate.

source: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Razor‐sharp icicles burst from the ground like soldiers thrusting their spears.
target: Swoosh! Swoosh! Swoosh! Glacies acutissimae e terra eruperunt, velut milites hastae suas immittens.

source: Franca quickly leaped up, pressing one hand against an icicle to tumble out of the area.
target: Franca celeriter insiluit, unam manum in glaciem prementem, ut ex area labaret.

source: She narrowly avoided impalement, hanging precariously from the icicle’s tip.
target: Vix impalationem evitavit, instabili modo ex acro glaciei suspendens.

source: Before Franca could regain her footing, black flames shot out from the shadows, hurtling directly towards her.
target: Antequam Franca pedes recuperaret, flammae nigrae ex umbris erupere, directae in eam impetum fecerunt.

source: The serpentine creatures around her constricted, binding her in layers.
target: Creaturae serpentiformes circa eam coarctabantur, eam in stratis circumligantes.

source: Wh– With no time to react, Franca could only watch helplessly as the black flames consumed her.
target: Heu – nullum tempus ad respondendum habens, Franca nihil nisi impotens spectare potuit, dum flammae nigrae eam consumebant.

source: At the same moment, a figure stepped out from the shadows–Clarice, wearing an elegant black court dress with her hair in a sophisticated bun.
target: Eodem tempore figura ex umbris emersit–Clarice, induta veste nigra curiae eleganti, et capillis in coleo subtili compositis.

source: However, the Demoness of Black’s face was blurry and dark, unlike a living person.
target: Attamen, vultus Daemonissae Nigrae obscurus atque confusus erat, dissimilis persona viva.

source: My crime is cheating, deceit, and exploiting others, mainly in reference to the Demoness Sect.
target: Crimen meum est fraus, dolus atque abusus aliorum, praesertim respectu Secta Daemonissae.

source: Is this punishment from a manifestation of the Demoness of Black?
target: Num haec poena ex manifestatione Daemonissae Nigrae provenit?

source: Franca’s thoughts raced.
target: Cogitationes Francae festinanter currebant.

source: Her body shattered like glass.
target: Corpus eius quasi vitrum confractum est.

source: Mirror Substitution!
target: Substitutio Speculi!

source: Jenna, while stealthily hidden, also encountered a strange foe.
target: Jenna, dum caute abscondita erat, hostem insolitum quoque invenit.

source: It was a clergyman from the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, dressed in a white robe adorned with golden threads.
target: Erat clericus e Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis, indutus veste alba, aureis filis ornata.

source: Not only were his facial features hazy and unrecognizable, but his physique was also constantly shifting in subtle ways.
target: Non solum facies eius obscurae et incognoscibiles erant, sed etiam corpus eius subtimis modis constanter mutabatur.

source: A blaze of sunlight descended, banishing the shadows in the area and exposing Jenna’s body.
target: Flamma solis deorsum descendit, umbras regionis expellens et corpus Jennæ revelans.

source: Realization dawned on Jenna.
target: Jennæ mox intellexit.

source: My crime is believing in multiple deities and betraying the Eternal Blazing Sun…
target: Crimen meum est pluribus deis credere et Aeternum Solem Flammantem prodere…

source: So, an abstract embodiment of the Church’s clergyman is punishing me…
target: Ita, incarnatio abstracta clerici Ecclesiae mihi poenam facit…

source: Jenna quickly rolled to the other side of the quarry cave, dodging the clergyman’s attack.
target: Jenna celeriter ad alteram partem speluncae lapidariae volvit, impetum clerici eludens.

source: Anthony was not forgotten.
target: Antonius non oblitus est.

source: Just as he prepared to use Psychological Invisibility to approach Perle and send her into a Frenzy, a whip wreathed in silver lightning lashed out at him.
target: Ita ut invisibilitatem psychologicam adhibere pararet, ut Perlem accedat et eam in furor induceret, flagrum, fulmine argenteo involutum, in eum percusit.

source: A crackling sound echoed in Anthony’s mind, both illusory and real, sending a sharp pain through his soul.
target: Sonus crepitans in mente Antonii resonavit, simul illusorius et verus, acutam dolorem per animam eius inferens.

source: Every hair on his body stood on end.
target: Omnes pili corporis eius erexerunt.

source: If not for his incredible self‑control, he would have screamed.
target: Nisi incredibile sua moderatione, clamavisset.

source: Before him stood a middle‑aged man in a black uniform and white shirt, dressed as a Trier police officer.
target: Ante eum stabat vir mediā aetāte, in uniforme nigro et camisia alba indutus, ut vigil Trevirensis.

source: My crime stems from my transgressions as an information broker, so I’m up against Trier’s police?
target: Crimen meum ex delictis ut mercator notitiarum provenit; ergo adversus vigilos Trevirenses sto?

source: Most Trier police officers lack Beyonder powers, yet this Punisher directly wields abilities in the Arbiter domain?
target: Plurimi vigilēs Trevirenses vim Beyonder non habent; attamen hic Puniōr in dominio Arbiter facultates directe utitur?

source: As Anthony conjured grayish‑white dragon scales on his body, he deftly ran and rolled, seeking a chance to use Psychological Invisibility.
target: Dum Antonius squamas draconum niveo‑griseas in corpore evocabat, callide cucurrit et volvit, occasionem invisibilitatis psychologicae adhibendae quaerens.

source: The already dim surroundings around Lumian suddenly darkened further, as if something was about to take shape, filling him with a profound sense of dread.
target: Circumiecta iam obscura Lumiani repente adhuc obscuriora facta sunt, quasi aliquid formari pararetur, eum profundo timoris sensu compleverunt.

source: Just as the terrifying entity was about to emerge, it abruptly disintegrated.
target: Ita ut terribilis entitas emergere pararetur, subito dissoluta est.

source: Even the surrounding gloom and fear dissipated like melting snow.
target: Etiam circumjacentia obscuritas et metus, velut nix liquescente, evanuerunt.

source: Uh… Is my crime too severe for a Punisher to manifest directly?
target: Eheu… Num crimen meum nimis grave est, ut Puniōr directe manifestari possit?

source: Lumian guessed, considering Franca and the others’ situations.
target: Lumian coniectavit, condicionem Francae et ceterorum considerans.

source: Behind him, spears of blazing white flame materialized and shot towards the flamboyantly dressed Perle like a volley of arrows.
target: Post eum, hastae flammae albae incandentes apparuerunt et versus Perlem, qui vestitu pomposo induta erat, quasi telis sagittabantur.

source: The flaming spears formed a majestic and fierce forest, providing cover for Lumian’s true attack.
target: Hastae flammantes silvam magnificam et ferocem formaverunt, tegmen praebentes verae impetūs Lumiani.

source: He had already drawn his revolver, gently flicking the cylinder with his finger.
target: Iam revolverum suum extraxerat, cylindrum leviter pollice commovebat.

source: Three of the six bullets he had obtained from Jebus were loaded.
target: Tria ex sex globulis, quos a Jebus obtinuerat, oneratae erant.

source: Lumian needed to use Implosion Bullets now.
target: Lumian nunc globulos implosivos adhibere oportebat.

source: Only by employing these special bullets in combination with his Cull ability did he have a sliver of hope of injuring Perle, whom he suspected to be the Overseer!
target: Solum his globulis specialibus, coniunctis cum facultate sua 'Cull', parva spes erat ut Perlem laederet, quam suspicabatur esse Inspectorem!

source: Bang!
target: Pum!

source: Lumian’s eyes blazed with an iron‑black intensity as the starlight‑shimmering bullets wove between the blazing white flame spears, speeding towards Perle’s neck.
target: Oculi Lumiani, ferro‑nigro fulgenti splendore, erant, dum globuli, ut astra scintillantes, inter hastae flammae albae incandentes texti celeriter versus collum Perlei properabant.

source: Perle stood beside the fixed entrance to the mirror world, her amiable smile unwavering.
target: Perle stabat iuxta ianuam fixam in mundo speculi, risus eius amabilis constans.

source: The corners of her mouth curled up.
target: Anguli oris eius incurvabantur.

source: “How dare you attack an Overseer?”
target: «Quomodo audes Inspectorem oppugnare?»

source: As the self‑proclaimed Overseer uttered her first word, Lumian’s starlight bullet abruptly changed course, hurtling towards his own neck.
target: Cum ipsa, se declarata Inspectrix, primum verbum edidit, globulus stellae fulgoris Lumiani subito cursum mutavit, versus suum collum properans.

source: Likewise, the blazing white flame spears strangely returned to Lumian’s side, engulfing him.
target: Similiter, hastae flammae albae incandescentes insolenter ad latus Lumiani redierunt, eum involventes.

source: Before Lumian could teleport, an Implosion Bullet struck him, causing his body to collapse bit by bit.
target: Antequam Lumian teleportare posset, globus implosivus eum percussit, quo corpus eius paulatim corruperet.

source: Crack!
target: Crepitum!

source: He transformed into a mirror, shattering into countless fragments that vanished without a trace as they gathered uncontrollably.
target: Se in speculum transformavit, innumeris fragmentis confractus, quae sine vestigio evanuerunt dum inordinate se congregabant.

source: After the battle with Jebus, Franca had provided Lumian with another Mirror Substitution!
target: Post proelium cum Jebus, Franca Lumiano aliam Substitutionem Speculi praebuerat!

source: Perle showed no surprise.
target: Perle nullum stuporem exhibuit.

source: She sighed and smiled.
target: Ea suspiravit et subridens.

source: “Personally, I’d prefer you die now and release that Angel. It would greatly benefit our common cause.
target: «Personaliter, potius velim te nunc mori et illum Angelum liberare; id causae nostrae communi magno prodesset.

source: Unfortunately, the one who made the Under the Table transaction with me insisted on capturing you alive.”
target: Infeliciter, is qui mecum sub mensa transactionem fecit, instanter te vivum capturum esse postulavit.»

source: Lumian materialized in a corner of the quarry cave, catching Perle’s words.
target: Lumian in angulo speluncae lapidariae se materializavit, verba Perlei capiens.

source: Instantly, numerous guesses flooded his mind.
target: Statim, multitudines coniecturarum mente eius inundaverunt.

source: Under the Table transaction?
target: Transactionem sub mensa?

source: Perle is the Overseer directly above Jebus.
target: Perle est Inspectrix directe super Jebus.

source: She evaded pursuit from the Major Arcana card holders by completing another high‑level Under the Table transaction.
target: Ea persecutionem a possessoribus chartarum Majoris Arcani evasit compleendo aliam transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus.

source: And for this, she must capture me and take me somewhere?
target: Et propter hoc, debet me captare atque me alibi ferre?

source: When did she find out about Moran Avigny’s situation?
target: Quando de condicione Moran Avigny cognovit?

source: Was she monitoring his residence?
target: Num eius domicilium observabat?

source: Or did she receive information from other sources?
target: An ex aliis fontibus notitiam accepit?

source: Surely the Purifiers are professional enough to keep the news under wraps, right?
target: Certe purgatores satis periti sunt ut nuntium celent, nonne?

source: Why capture me alive?
target: Cur me vivum capere?

source: Who wants me alive?
target: Quis me vivum vult?

source: To use me as a sacrifice, like Susanna Mattise?
target: Ut me, sicut Susanna Mattise, ut sacrificium adhibeat?

source: Or could the person engaging in Perle’s Under the Table transaction be a Sufferer from the Sinners organization?
target: Aut num persona, quae in transactione sub mensa cum Perle versatur, sit Patiens ex organizatione Peccatorum?

source: Someone who doesn’t want Termiboros to break free from the seal, but instead wants to control this Angel and use Him as an ingredient for advancement?
target: Aliquis qui non vult Termiboros e sigillo liberari, sed potius hunc Angelum regere ac ut rem ad progressionem adhiberet?

source: No, that’s not right.
target: Non, id non rectum est.

source: If he were just a Sufferer, even if he could mislead Madam Magician and the others temporarily, he couldn’t prevent them from returning to help.
target: Si solum esset Patiens, etiamsi Dominam Magicam et ceteros temporarie fallere posset, eos ad auxilium redire non prohiberet.

source: Yet, Perle remains calm and collected…
target: Attamen, Perle manet tranquilla et composita…

source: Could the other party in the Under the Table transaction be a faction of the Mother Tree of Desire or the Great Mother?
target: Num altera pars transactionis sub mensa esset pars Arboris Matris Desiderii aut Magna Mater?

source: Only they could organize a lineup in this world to deal with the Major Arcana card holders…
target: Soli illi possent congregare ordinem in hoc mundo ad tractandum possessoribus chartarum Magni Arcani…

source: With his keen Conspirer’s intuition, Lumian connected two problems.
target: Cum acuto sensu coniuratoris suo, Lumian duas quaestiones coniunxit.

source: First, the counter‐party of Overseer Perle’s Under the Table transaction.
target: Primum, contraria pars transactionis sub mensa Inspectricis Perlei.

source: Second, how she discovered Moran Avigny’s mishap so quickly and promptly convened a high‑level Under the Table transaction.
target: Secundum, quomodo celeriter casum Moran Avigny detexit et statim transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus convocavit.

source: As these questions intertwined, a thought struck Lumian.
target: Dum hae quaestiones inter se conexae erant, cogitatio Lumiani percusit.

source: In the Purifier team, a key member of April Fool’s wasn’t a transmigrator.
target: In turma Purgatorum, membrum principale Aprilis Stultorum non erat transmigrator.

source: Together with Loki, he single‑handily orchestrated the loss of the humanoid Sealed Artifact.
target: Una cum Loki, solus orchestravit amissionem Artifacti Sigillati, qui humanoide erat.

source: To this day, the Eternal Blazing Sun Church hasn’t discovered the perpetrator!
target: Ad hanc diem, Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis perpetratorem nondum detexit!

source: Could a Broker also be involved?
target: Potestne etiam intermedius interesse?

source: Indeed, only if a key April Fool’s member lurking within the Church appears unrelated to the Purifier who lost the humanoid Sealed Artifact, and they don’t even know each other, can the Eternal Blazing Sun Church, with its numerous Sealed Artifacts and demigods, investigate for so long without finding anything!
target: Certe, solum si membrum clavis Aprilis Stultorum intra Ecclesiam latentis, qui non sit coniunctus cum Purgatore qui Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem amisit, et si invicem ne cognoscant quidem, Ecclesia Aeternae Solis Flammantis, cum multis Artifactis Sigillatis et semideis, tam diu investigare possit sine quidquam inveniendo!

source: From the Eternal Blazing Sun Church’s perspective, the Purifier who lost the humanoid Sealed Artifact truly committed a momentary “mistake.”
target: Ex prospectu Ecclesiae Aeternae Solis Flammantis, Purgator qui Artifactum Sigillatum humanoidem amisit, vere errorem momentaneum commisit.

source: He had no motive for the crime and no links to April Fool’s…
target: Nihil habebat causae criminis neque nexum cum Aprilis Stultorum…

source: Has the School of Truth expanded the Broker business into the Eternal Blazing Sun Church?
target: Num Schola Veritatis negotium intermedii in Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Flammantis propagavit?

source: It’s true; only Unshadowed won’t be embroiled in gray transactions, and most Purifiers can’t reach Sequence 4.
target: Verum est; solum Unshadowed non implicabuntur in transactionibus griseis, et plerique Purgatores Sequenciam Quartam attingere non possunt.

source: Similarly, not all Cardinals are from the Sun pathway…
target: Similiter, non omnes Cardinales e via Solis proveniunt…

source: It seems the School of Truth has long been connected to April Fool’s and is collaborating…
target: Videtur Schola Veritatis diu ad Aprilis Stultorum coniuncta esse et cooperari…

source: Damn it, it really is a broker organization.
target: Maledictum, vere est societas intermedii.

source: It can be associated with any faction!
target: Ad quamlibet factionem pertinere potest!

source: Could it be that the School of Truth’s collaborator within the Eternal Blazing Sun Church urgently transmitted information about Moran Avigny’s mishap to Overseer Perle?
target: Num fieri potest ut collaborans Scholae Veritatis intra Ecclesiam Aeternae Solis Flammantis de casu Moran Avigny notitiam ad Inspectricem Perlem celerrime transmittat?

source: Upon receiving the news, Perle immediately convened a high‑level Under the Table transaction.
target: Notitiam receptam, Perle statim transactionem sub mensa altioris gradus convocavit.

source: Was the transaction with April Fool’s?
target: Fuitne transactio cum Aprilis Stultorum?

source: No, April Fool’s doesn’t have that power.
target: Non, Aprilis Stultorum hanc potentiam non habet.

source: Could it be the Celestial Worthy backing them or other high‑ranking subordinates of the Celestial Worthy?
target: Num fortasse Cœlestis Dignus eos adiuvat, aut alii subditi altioris gradus Cœlestis Digni existimantur?

source: No wonder they want to capture me alive…
target: Non mirum est eos me vivum capturum esse velle…

source: Perle might have intended to offer an item in exchange for severing her connection with Moran Avigny.
target: Fortasse Perle volebat rem offerre in commutatione ut vinculum suum cum Moran Avigny solveret.

source: However, the counter‑party in the Under the Table transaction proposed a new plan, allowing her to switch from passive to active, seizing the opportunity to deceive and set a trap.
target: Attamen, oppositio in transactione sub mensa novum consilium proposuit, quod ei permittebat ut a passiva ad activam mutaretur, occasionem capiens ad decipiendum et laqueum constituendum.

source: How far it can go depends on her improvisation…
target: Quousque procedere possit, in eius improvisatione dependet…

source: If it is indeed April Fool’s and the Celestial Worthy’s will is faintly discernible, it would explain why Madam Magician didn’t sense anything amiss and walked right into the trap.
target: Si vere Aprilis Stultorum est et voluntas Cœlestis Digni leviter perceptibilis, id explicaret cur Domina Magica nihil insolitum sentiret et directo in laqueum incidisset.

source: Realizing this, Lumian was alarmed.
target: Hoc intellegens, Lumian consternatus est.

source: Termiboros warned me twice about the School of Truth.
target: Termiboros me bis de Schola Veritatis monuit.

source: Could it be that He foresaw the corresponding fate unfold and a chance for Him to break free from the seal?
target: Num ille fatum correspondens praevidit et occasionem habuit se a sigillo liberari?

source: Is that why He was so eager, hoping to compel it into fruition?
target: Num idcirco tam ardens fuit, sperans ut id ad effectum perduceret?
